_comment: Ground truth for scripts/benchmark-rerank.ts. Every question here is answerable from a law whose indexed text has been verified CLEAN (التجارة id 159, العمل id 160, الشركات id 161 — all re-ingested from lob.gov.jo .txt). قانون العقوبات (id 3) is deliberately absent: its stored text is character-corrupted, so any criminal-law question would measure the corpus defect rather than the reranker. Re-ingest it from a clean source before adding جزائي cases.
_metric: hit@8 = an ACCEPTED chunk appears in the top 8; rank = its 1-based position; MRR = mean of 1/rank. A case with `expectArticles` is scored at article level (the chunk must be that article of that law); without it, law level. Article-level is where the headroom is: law-level alone scores a saturated 12/12 MRR 1.000 on this corpus, which cannot discriminate between rerankers.
_ground_truth: Article numbers were read off the indexed statute text itself (scripts probe of legal_documents), not recalled — e.g. التجارة م.6 opens 'تعد الاعمال التالية ... اعمالا تجارية برية'. Where a topic legitimately spans several articles, all acceptable numbers are listed.
